description: In-memory reference implementation of the atomic Notion aggregate persistence contract.

members.name: GetSnapshot
members.description: Returns a defensive copy of a currently stored page snapshot.

members.name: Seed
members.description: Adds or replaces one seeded page without incrementing save counters.

members.name: LastSaveRequest
members.description: Gets a defensive copy of the most recent save request.

members.name: LoadCallCount
members.description: Gets the number of aggregate load calls observed by this instance.

members.name: SaveCallCount
members.description: Gets the number of atomic save calls observed by this instance.
